## 中文

**v0.6.4 · Android build 71**

Remote 0.6.4 聚焦 Android 与桌面端体验。新增 DS Bot 0.3.0 会话与设置、离线会话秒开、缓存阅读、工作区快捷创建、主机切换和连接诊断，并改进 DSH-Go 配对、二维码登录和服务地址配置。同时修复超大会话目录、身份恢复、重连与自部署 Server 刷新恢复问题，新增 Windows Codex CLI 发现并统一发布 bundle 路径。

感谢 @dreamfarer-space、@bluesmilery、@ltmroberthk915、@jinnian0703、@joeatgp，以及所有参与评审、测试、反馈问题和改进文档的贡献者。

## English

**v0.6.4 · Android build 71**

Remote 0.6.4 focuses on the Android and desktop experience. It adds DS Bot 0.3.0 conversations and settings, offline session instant-open, cached reading, direct workspace creation, host switching and connection diagnostics. It also improves DSH-Go pairing, QR sign-in and server address configuration, while fixing oversized session catalogues, identity recovery, reconnect handling and self-hosted refresh recovery. Windows Codex CLI discovery and normalized release bundle paths are included as well.

Thanks to @dreamfarer-space, @bluesmilery, @ltmroberthk915, @jinnian0703, @joeatgp, and everyone who contributed through reviews, testing, issue reports and documentation improvements.
